items.title: 3.10 Ionic, covalent, metallic bonds aur intermolecular forces ka comparison (muqabla) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.10, printed page 69.

blocks.text: Chemical bonds, yani ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds, aam taur par asal (true) chemical bonds kehlate hain, kyun ke yeh substance ki chemical properties par asar dalte hain. Is ki kuch wajahein hain. Pehli: chemical bonds electrons ke transfer aur sharing se nayi species (naye particles) banate hain. Jabke intermolecular forces sirf molecules ko qareeb lati hain aur physical properties par asar dalti hain. Lekin chemical bonds aur intermolecular forces mein itna saaf farq karna mumkin nahi. In dono ki khas pehchan un ki bond strength (mazbooti) hai, aur force ki mazbooti bond energy se napi jati hai. Table 3.4 alag chemical bonds aur intermolecular forces ka comparison dikhata hai.

blocks.caption: Table 3.4 Chemical bonds aur intermolecular forces ki mazbooti

blocks.text: Ionic bond (sodium chloride, 760 kJ mol⁻¹) ki bond energy sab se zyada hai, us ke baad covalent bond (O–H = 464 kJ mol⁻¹), aur phir hydrogen bond ki average energy (20-25 kJ mol⁻¹). Is se pata chalta hai ke ionic bond sab se mazboot chemical bond hai, aur chemical bonds aam taur par intermolecular forces se bohat mazboot hain. Permanent dipole-dipole forces (5-20 kJ mol⁻¹) aur London dispersion forces (1-20 kJ mol⁻¹) in se bhi kamzor hain, jaisa un ki kam bond energies batati hain.

Metallic bond ko zyada tar electrostatic forces (charges ki attraction) se samjhaya jata hai, halanke kuch theories kehti hain ke yeh covalent qism ka ho sakta hai. Jo bhi ho, metallic bond ionic aur covalent dono bonds se kamzor hai. Metallic bond ki average bond energy 100-150 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Is ki kam mazbooti ki achhi wajah yeh hai ke metallic crystal mein electrons bohat phaile hue (delocalized) hote hain, kisi ek jagah bandhe nahi.

blocks.prompt: Metallic bond ionic aur covalent bonds se kamzor kyun hai, aur ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds 'true' chemical bonds kyun kehlate hain jabke van der Waals forces nahi?
blocks.explanation: Metal mein valence electrons do atoms ke beech bandhe rehne ke bajaye poore crystal mein phaile (delocalized) hote hain, is liye attraction (kashish) phail kar kamzor ho jati hai: average sirf 100-150 kJ mol⁻¹. Ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds electrons de kar ya share kar ke nayi species banate hain aur chemical properties decide karte hain; intermolecular forces sirf molecules ko qareeb lati hain, physical properties par asar dalti hain, aur bohat kamzor hain (1-50 kJ mol⁻¹).

items: True chemical bonds (ionic, covalent, metallic) nayi species banate aur chemical properties decide karte hain; intermolecular forces molecules ko qareeb lati aur physical properties decide karti hain. Mazbooti: NaCl ionic 760 > O–H covalent 464 > metallic 100-150 > hydrogen bond 20-50 > dipole-dipole 5-20 > van der Waals 1-20 kJ mol⁻¹.
